On September 20, 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced the first combat use of the domestically produced FP-7 “Pelican” tactical ballistic missile.
Developed by Fire Point, the road-mobile, solid-fuel system has a stated range of up to 200–300 km and can carry a warhead of up to 150 kg. It was developed as a lower-cost Ukrainian alternative to the U.S.-made ATACMS.
As a domestically developed strike system, the FP-7 gives Ukraine greater freedom to employ its long-range weapons against military targets in Russia without the foreign-use restrictions associated with donated Western weapons.
